question:

Then, Bob and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Fred and Eve swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Fred and Gertrude swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Dave has the
Options:
(A) white present
(B) orange ball
(C) black ball
(D) pink ball
(E) purple present
(F) green present
(G) brown present
